description: Billing-grade usage for your org over a date window, from the daily rollup (usage_daily), grouped by day, project, engine, feature or key. group_by=key returns per API key (key_id, name, prefix, project_id) counters per metric per day, from usage_key_daily; keyless (dashboard) usage is not in it, and a project-scoped key sees only its own project's keys. Use it to answer 'how many requests/credits did I use, and where'. The window defaults to the last 30 days including today; `to` is EXCLUSIVE (a single day 2026-08-01 is from=2026-08-01, to=2026-08-02) and the window may not exceed 400 days. The response carries stale_seconds (age of the newest rollup row; null when the window is empty). Requires the key to have the `read` scope.

from.description: Inclusive start date, YYYY-MM-DD (UTC). Default: 29 days before today.

group_by.description: How to group the rows. Default 'day'.

metrics.description: Metrics to return. Omit for all of them.

project_id.description: Restrict to one project id (must be a valid Spicrawl identifier).

to.description: EXCLUSIVE end date, YYYY-MM-DD (UTC). Default: tomorrow, so today is included.

name: spicrawl_usage

group_by.description: The dimension used: day, project, engine, feature or key.

key.description: The bucket: a YYYY-MM-DD day, a project id, an engine tier (fetch, js or browser) or a feature (extract, ai_extract, proxy_datacenter, proxy_residential, batch).

label.description: Human label for an engine tier.

metrics.description: Metric name -> quantity. credits are micro-credits (1 credit = 1000000), engine_ms milliseconds, bytes_* bytes, the rest counts.

groups.description: The buckets, sorted by key. Empty (or missing for group_by=key) does not mean no usage: read totals.

prefix.description: Display prefix of the API key, never the secret.

totals.description: Metric name -> quantity. credits are micro-credits (1 credit = 1000000), engine_ms milliseconds, bytes_* bytes, the rest counts.

keys.description: group_by=key only: one entry per API key, with its counters per UTC day.

period.description: The window, as a half-open range of UTC days.

stale_seconds.description: Age of usage_as_of in seconds; null when the window is empty. A large value means the rollup is behind.

totals.description: Billed quantities for the whole window. Authoritative; use these, not the sum of groups.

unattributed.description: The part of each total the groups do not explain.

usage_as_of.description: When the newest rollup row in the window was written; null when the window is empty.

warnings.description: Caveats the numbers would otherwise hide.

title: Usage breakdown
